method.fill_rule: limit at entry, fills if Low touches within 3 sessions
method.conservative: same-bar stop counts as a loss; targets only count on touch after fill
method.universe: Buy-rated = verdict Buy/Strong Buy AND R:R-valid; all-setups = every R:R-valid setup regardless of verdict

backfill_note: Rows marked 'backfill' are a simulated walk-forward replay of the engine on historical data — not signals published in advance.

portfolio.cost_note: Every trade is charged a realistic PSX round trip (0.15% or 3 paisa/share per side, whichever is higher, plus 15% tax on commission). Gross figures would be materially higher and are not achievable.
portfolio.rules: Every Buy/Strong Buy-rated valid setup takes a 20% slot of equity; its audited P/L (incl. losses, expiries, fills) is applied at trade close and compounds. No hindsight, no cherry-picking.

weights_log.reason: momentum-driven signals won 40% vs 52% overall over 30d (n=200)
